item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will become cool and windy over the coastal areas of southern China today. The weather will improve in the following couple of days. It will be cool in the morning and at night, very dry during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to moderate gradually in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will rise over Guangdong. The weather will be persistently fine and dry.

Date/Month: 16/03 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore, up to force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two showers at first. Dry with sunny intervals during the day. Cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 50 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
